Real hardware/aarch64 USB kernel/automatic KILL recovery/TLS/ISO and future UI limits retained.

nonblocking_findings.issue: Backend tab state is not reflected in the URL; loading #panel-physical still selects Native and hides the target.
nonblocking_findings.recommendation: Optionally initialize from an allowlisted panel hash and preserve valid tab state with hashchange/history.replaceState. Existing public links target #explore, so the shipped documented navigation works.

scope_limits: No browser or screenshots used; rendering, zoom, actual assistive technology and clipboard permission behavior are not proven by this static/stub review.
No Cargo/QEMU/device operation executed; this review does not add software/device test coverage.
